import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # vertical separator: full-height non-bg column
    sep=None
    for c in range(W):
        v=g[0][c]
        if v!=bg and all(row[c]==v for row in g):
            sep=c; break
    if sep is None: return out
    # shape cells (non-bg, non-sep)
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c)!=(any(False,False)) ]
    scells=[(r,c) for r,c,_ in cells]
    cc=min(c for _,c in scells); cl=max(c for _,c in scells)
    side = 'L' if sep>cl else 'R'   # sep left of shape -> draw right of shape
    col = cl+1 if side=='R' else cc-1
    for r in range(H):
        if 0<=col<W and out[r][col]==bg: out[r][col]=8
    return out

    print(p, r)
print(allok, json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for p in ['4','5','6']:
    i,o=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    print('--- demo',p)
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in i for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0])
    sepcol=[c for c in range(W) if all(r[c]==i[0][c] and i[0][c]!=bg for r in i)]
    seprow=[r for r in range(H) if all(i[r][c]==i[r][0] and i[r][0]!=bg for c in range(W))]
    spt=set(cnt)-{bg}
    sepv=[v for v in spt if any(all(row[c]==v for row in i) for c in range(W)) or any(all(i[r][c]==v for c in range(W)) for r in range(H))]
    print('H W bg sepcol seprow sepvals',sepcol,seprow,sepv)
    e8={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if o[r][c]==8}
    print('eights:',sorted(e8))

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    zero=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==0]
    twos=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    rs={r for r,_ in twos}; cs={c for _,c in twos}
    horiz = len(rs)==H
    if horiz:
        lr=min(r for r,_ in twos)
        top=min(r for r,_ in zero); bot=max(r for r,_ in zero)
        h=bot-top+1
        nr=lr-h                  # shape flush directly above the line
        for (r,c) in zero:
            out[nr+r-top][c]=0
        for c in range(W): out[lr][c]=8
    else:                          # vertical line at col L
        L=max(c for _,c in twos)
        lmin=min(c for _,c in zero); lmax=max(c for _,c in zero)
        w=lmax-lmin+1
        nc=L-w                    # shape flush directly left of the line
        for (r,c) in zero:
            out[r][nc+c-lmin]=0
        for r in range(H): out[r][L]=8
    return out

# sanity on demos

print('shape bbox rows',min(r for r,_ in z),max(r for r,_ in z),'cols',min(c for _,c in z),max(c for _,c in z))

def solve(g):

    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # find main shape component (largest connected group of 0s); use its bbox

        h=max(r for r,_ in main)-min(r for r,_ in main)+1
        if min(r for r,_ in main)>lr:   # shape below line: place directly above, touching line
            nr=lr-1
        else:                          # shape above line: place directly below, touching line
            nr=lr+1
        for (r,c) in main:
            out[nr+(r-min(r for r,_ in main))][c]=0
        for c in range(W): out[lr][c]=8
    else:                   # vertical line at col lc... anchor is max col of twos (line runs full width)
        L=max(c for _,c in twors if False else [c for _,c in twors])

        else:                              # shape right of line: slide left until left edge = lc+1

    vert = len(two_rows)>1

        lcol=next(iter(two_cols))

        zcols=[c for _,c in zeros]; sgn = 1 if max(zcols)<lcol else -1
        hcol = lcol + sgn*3   # 8-line 3 away on shape's side

        zmax=max(zcols); zmin=min(zcols)
        # slide shape until flush against 8-column on the far side of the 8-col from line
        tgt_max = hcol-sgn          # zeros occupy hcol-sgn .. hcol-2sgn
        if sgn==1: tgt_min,hgt=tgt_max-1,tgt_max
        else: tgt_min,tgt_max=hcol+2,hcol
        for r,c in zeros: out[r][c]=6
        dr=(tgt_max-zmax)
        for r,c in zeros: out[r][c+dr]=0
        for r in range(H): out[r][hcol]=8
    else:    # horizontal 2-line, shape moves vertically
        lrow=next(iter(two_rows))
        zrows=[r for r,_ in zeros]; sgn = 1 if min(zrows)>lrow else -1

        for r,c in zeros: out[r][c]=6
        for r,c in zeros: out[r+(tgt_min-zmin)][c]=0
        for c in range(W): out[hrow][c]=8
    return out
